items.author: Musk
items.text: CME Group Is Launching Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX Futures Contracts on July 27. Here's the Investment Case.
items.summary_cn: 芝商所(CME)将于7月27日上线Tesla和SpaceX期货合约——重大事件，机构可正式做空/做多定价，深度利好SpaceX二级流动性与SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s Net Worth Drops $50 Billion In Latest SpaceX Selloff
items.summary_cn: Musk净资产因SpaceX二级份额抛售缩水500亿美元，SpaceX内部卖出信号，直接影响SPCX/SPCH估值锚点。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Trump cheers Gwynne Shotwell as Elon Musk’s SpaceX No. 2 gives $325 million in stock to Trump Accounts
items.summary_cn: Trump与Musk互动新闻：Shotwell捐赠SpaceX股票至'Trump Accounts'，政治背书+慈善叙事共振，利好SpaceX品牌。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Thank you to the brilliant and highly respected Gwynne Shotwell, and her husband, Robert, for their extreme Generosity in helping children to attain the ever magnificent American Dream! Their Gift of 325 Million Dollars of SpaceX Stock is greatly appreciated by all. Thousands of children have just been given a better life. Thank you Gwynne and Robert, and continued Great Success! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump公开赞赏SpaceX总裁Gwynne Shotwell捐赠3.25亿美元SpaceX股票用于慈善，间接强化SpaceX品牌/估值利好。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Opinion | It’s a World-Class Investment. It’s a Junk Investment. What Is Going on With SpaceX?
items.summary_cn: 主流媒体报道SpaceX估值争议——既是'世界级投资'也是'垃圾投资'，直接影响其二级份额估值与SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Wall Street Finds a New Way to Help Investors Avoid Elon Musk
items.summary_cn: 华尔街推出新工具让投资者绕开直接投资Musk系公司门槛，提及SpaceX/Tesla相关投资产品，结构性利好SPCX/SPCH等替代标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk says he always wanted his SpaceX employees to get rich — and now thousands of them are millionaires
items.summary_cn: Musk表示希望SpaceX员工致富，如今数千人已成百万富翁，强化SpaceX作为'造富机器'的叙事，利好估值预期。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump announces Walmart to lower prices for thousands of products at his administration's request: https://justthenews.com/nation/economy/trump-announces-walmart-lower-prices-thousands-products-his-administrations-request
items.summary_cn: Trump宣布Walmart应其政府请求下调数千种商品价格，关注通胀/消费板块及关税传导效应。

items.author: Musk
items.text: What a brief encounter with Elon Musk taught me about the limits of capitalism
items.summary_cn: 关于与Musk短暂接触引发对资本主义局限思考的评论文章，间接涉及Tesla/Musk企业文化。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Fed Reserve working paper suggests Biden illegal immigrant wave caused 30% of home price increases: https://justthenews.com/government/security/fed-reserve-working-paper-suggests-biden-illegal-immigrant-wave-drove-hom
items.summary_cn: Trump转发联储工作论文，称Biden非法移民潮推高房价30%，为其移民/驱逐政策辩护，间接看空地产或强化反移民政策叙事。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump fan or not, economists say Trump accounts are a good deal: https://justthenews.com/politics-policy/all-things-trump/trump-fan-or-not-economists-say-trump-accounts-are-good-deal
items.summary_cn: Trump宣传'Trump Accounts'儿童储蓄账户获经济学家好评，财政补贴型储蓄产品，对金融/零售板块有间接政策利好。

items.author: Musk
items.text: What will define Elon Musk’s legacy? Doge cuts to USAID Ebola programs
items.summary_cn: 评论DOGE削减USAID项目对Musk遗产定义，与kcn持仓无直接市场含义，仅作为Musk政治影响力旁注。
